label: Act priority at a first being from Metaphysics Theta.8: substance routes, plenitude, rivals
summary: Target: premise warrant for act priority at a first being (61ad11f3) and its composition-route inputs 8288ff1e and 3d99779b, from Metaphysics Theta.8 (1049b4-1051a3) read as analyst reconstructions, attribution deferred (no new claims; locators are navigation). Per priority. (1) In definition (1049b12-17): potency is said by reference to its act. The shared respect index of InPotency x r and InAct y r records only that and constrains no being; read more strongly as 'potency in r makes act in r possible' it is the open bridge 7371403f, which the plenitude-plus-change-cause route uses (item 4). (2) In time (1049b17-1050a3): reaches only potencies being actualized and is vacuous at a first being's idle potency (ATTEMPT-ACT-PRIOR-FROM-MOTION, ATTEMPT-MET-IX-8-ACTUAL-MOVER-PRIORITY; not repeated). (3) In substance, the eternal (1050b6-19, with In Metaph. IX lect. 9): excludes only potency in being (ATTEMPT-ACT-PRIOR-FROM-INCORRUPTIBLE). New: inActOfIncorruptible derives 8288ff1e from 'every first being is simply incorruptible' (ca55ed3a, open analyst) and the sourced reading d017b6b0; firstBeingNoPotencyOfThetaEight composes the existing firstBeingNoPotencyOfComposition (act read as act in being) to derive the q.3 a.1 conclusion 0cf675c4 from ca55ed3a, d017b6b0, the restricted composition premise d8024a38 (act in being plus potency makes composite), ca07cae9, e0088de9 and e078f07b; each of the six is needed (Control.ThetaEightOmissions, models from scripts/countermodel.py, rechecked). d8024a38 is strictly weaker than 3d99779b (strength order, Control.RestrictedStrict) and equivalent to it given STMT-ACTUALITY-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING (Control.Facts); the two existing composition arguments now record strong_version_needed. Control.HeavenlyFirst: the Theta.8 substance readings, first-being incorruptibility, 8288ff1e and non-overlap leave a first being in potency to a place, so without a composition premise Theta.8 does not reach 61ad11f3. Control.ContingentFirst: 8288ff1e does not imply ca55ed3a, so the Theta.8 support for 8288ff1e is more committal than 8288ff1e itself, an alternative support, not a weaker warrant. (4) Plenitude plus change-cause (Theta.8 1050a4-b2 on potency for the sake of act is orientation only): firstBeingNoPotencyOfPlenitude derives the time-indexed sibling 8caca2bf (a first being is in POTENCY_2 in no respect at the time now; new statement) from b9baf50d (plenitude over an infinite past, existing tertia via reading B), d256e6d2 (the past is infinite, existing), 7371403f (definitional priority read as: potency in a respect at a time makes act in it possible in the plenitude reading's sense; open analyst bridge) and 966c08c6 (what was in act in a respect and is later in potency in it has an efficient cause other than itself; open analyst), with e078f07b. It uses no composition premise and does not use ca07cae9; each premise needed and nonvacuous (Control.PlenitudeOmissions). Repair after semantic challenge: it was first bound to the untimed 0cf675c4, whose consumers pass from pure actuality to immutability and eternity; at InPotencyAt now that is a temporal equivocation, and the only uniform untimed instantiation needs Before t t, which empties 966c08c6. It is now bound to the timed sibling only, and does not reach the root. Connection plan: the untimed statement, with potency read as potency at some time, would follow from the five premises at every time (plenitude and an infinite past at every time), or through an open bridge from untimed potency to potency at now; neither is registered. (5) weakOfThetaEight derives 61ad11f3 directly from the six Theta.8-route premises (all POTENCY_2). Repair after semantic challenge: a first version registered 0cf675c4 -> 61ad11f3, which let the POTENCY_1 act-priority route (a4d3261a, c6d6379b) reach the POTENCY_2-labelled 61ad11f3 through the sense-neutral 0cf675c4 without a sense bridge; it was withdrawn. (6) Joint rival model Control.IdleUncausedComposite: one interpretation satisfies every premise of the composition, Theta.8 and plenitude-plus-change-cause routes except ca07cae9 and plenitude, with a composite, uncaused first being in potency to a place it never actualizes. It shows only that rejecting {ca07cae9, plenitude} suffices. Minimal rejection sets for a first being in potency (one premise of each route; rejecting d8024a38 also rejects 3d99779b, which implies it): {e078f07b}; {x, y} with x one of ca07cae9, e0088de9, d8024a38 and y one of b9baf50d, d256e6d2, 7371403f, 966c08c6; {a, b, y} with a one of 8288ff1e, 3d99779b and b one of ca55ed3a, d017b6b0. Rejecting 3d99779b alone does not suffice formally, since the Theta.8 route survives through d8024a38. The strong act-priority readings are further routes. Graph at STMT-GOD-EXISTS (strict expansion as in docs/notes/spine-dependency-map.md: a statement with a verified derivation may not be a leaf; 12 root arguments on origin/main 3286fec9), with the strong act-priority premises a4d3261a and 3b2d2d46 removed, before -> after the repair: removing also 8288ff1e 2/12 -> 12/12 (Theta.8 route via weakOfThetaEight); 3d99779b 2/12 -> 2/12 (d8024a38 is derived from 3d99779b, so under strict expansion it is not a leaf once 3d99779b is removed; under the lenient reading the Theta.8 route would survive); ca07cae9 2/12 -> 2/12; e0088de9 1/12 -> 1/12; 61ad11f3 2/12 -> 2/12; e078f07b 0/12 -> 0/12; removing ca55ed3a alone (with the strong premises) leaves 12/12 through the composition route. The counts first reported (ca07cae9 2 -> 11, 3d99779b 2 -> 12, e0088de9 1 -> 3) rested on the withdrawn time-equivocal binding of the plenitude route and the withdrawn sense-crossing argument. Route survival is support redundancy, not establishment. Rivals (substantive objection standard; literature named from memory is unread). (a) Contingent first being (Oppy-style contingent initial state, unread): targets ca55ed3a; mechanism: the first being exists but can fail to be; blocks the Theta.8 route only, not the composition route (8288ff1e still holds, ContingentFirst); price: brute contingency of the first being, whose conflict with the corpus's PSR premises is not tested here. (b) Dipolar or process theism (Hartshorne, Whitehead, unread): a first being whose concrete states are composite, unrealized and in part actualized by creatures. Formally it must reject ca07cae9 at a first being (the existing uncaused-composite rival 9ba56a92) and, against the plenitude route, either plenitude (inexhaustible never-actualized potencies) or, where creatures actualize the potency, e078f07b in its respect-unrestricted form (creatures causing an accidental state of God are not simply prior to God); price: priority indexed to respects, which the corpus's PRIOR_1 does not express and no record yet formalizes. Not an established counterexample. (c) Powers ontologies (Molnar; Mumford and Anjum, unread): unmanifested powers of fundamental bearers; mechanism against the plenitude route (manifestation is not required for a power to be real) and against ca07cae9 (uncaused composite fundamentals). Relevance depends on an untested mapping: POTENCY_2 is passive, receptive potency, while many powers are active, which no premise here constrains. (d) Finite past: targets d256e6d2; independent justification: ST I q.46 a.2 (the world's beginning is held by faith, already recorded in the TertiaVia docstring) and the Catholic doctrine of creation with a temporal beginning; if the past is finite the plenitude reading yields nothing, so the plenitude route cannot serve the Catholic root unconditionally. No formal incompatibility with a root statement has been tested. (e) Self-change against 966c08c6 (a self-moving first principle, as in Plato's self-moving soul): mechanism, a being changes in a respect without an efficient cause other than itself; it targets 966c08c6 directly; independent justification is not recorded here. 'Quantum transitions' and the reply that a self-changer has an internal mover and moved (Physics VIII.5, hence composition) are unsupported suggestions with no evidential weight: no mechanism is given for either. (f) d8024a38: no substantive objection identified under the inclusive SIMPLE_4 reading; the load lies on ca07cae9. 7371403f: its 'possible' is the plenitude reading's supplied predicate, now defined stipulatively (db0f415c: realizability at some time), and DISAMB-CAN-BE-MODAL-CAPACITY is linked. The step starts from POTENCY_2, not from the IX.6 capacity CanBe (ABLE_TO_BE_1), and yields the plenitude possibility, which is not accessible-world ModalCapacity (ABLE_TO_BE_2); 7371403f is the explicit bridge, not an identification. On that stipulated sense no substantive objection is identified, but the premise is not definitional: a potency's realizability at some time is exactly what the idle-potency rival denies, so its weight with plenitude is a single commitment to realized potencies, not two independent ones. Overall provisional judgment: of Theta.8's priorities only priority in substance gives anything at a first being, plus definitional priority once it is read as the open bridge 7371403f. The eternal argument supplies an alternative support for 8288ff1e and, with a weaker composition premise, the q.3 a.1 conclusion and first-being act priority, but it is more committal than 8288ff1e and leaves the decisive premise ca07cae9 untouched. The plenitude-plus-change-cause reconstruction avoids ca07cae9 but yields only no potency at the time now, which does not reach the root's untimed consumers without premises at every time or a further bridge, and it rests on plenitude over an infinite past, which Aquinas does not assert and the Catholic root's doctrine of a temporal beginning is generally taken to deny; it is a conditional, unconnected support. Support for 61ad11f3 remains moderate and rests on the composition and Theta.8 routes, which share ca07cae9, e0088de9 and e078f07b; the live crux is still whether a first being can be an uncaused composite (ca07cae9 at a first being) or have only respect-indexed priority (e078f07b). Revision conditions: raise if ca07cae9 is derived or defended at a first being (e.g. from the corpus's PSR premises) or if e078f07b's respect-unrestricted form gains an independent defense; lower if a read dipolar or powers text supplies a coherent respect-indexed priority compatible with the other root premises; connect the plenitude route only with plenitude-route premises at every time or a defended timed-to-untimed bridge, and retire it for the Catholic root if a corpus statement of a temporal beginning is shown to contradict d256e6d2 on the same Before/now profile. Nothing is established; every new premise is open.
blocker: Open: every new premise (ca55ed3a, d8024a38, 7371403f, 966c08c6) and the reused ones; the decisive question remains ca07cae9 at a first being and e078f07b's respect-unrestricted form. Next tests: (0) connection plan for the timed plenitude conclusion 8caca2bf: premises at every time or an open timed-to-untimed bridge, checked against the eternity consumers; (1) search for a corpus statement of a temporal beginning and test joint satisfiability with d256e6d2 on one Before/now profile; (2) formalize respect-indexed priority (PriorIn c x r) and test whether e078f07b's unrestricted form follows from it plus a bridge, or whether a dipolar model satisfies the respect-indexed version with every other root premise; (3) derive ca07cae9 at a first being from existing PSR premises, or record why not. Literature named here (Oppy, Hartshorne, Whitehead, Molnar, Mumford and Anjum) is unread.
